title: Rust library component diagram
description: The Cargo package utv: the library source and its tests, the shared material they read in place, and the crates they depend on. chrono is an optional dependency of the library (feature chrono) and, with chrono-tz, a dev-dependency of the tests.

components.name: utv crate (implementations/rust)
components.responsibility: One Cargo package: the library and its tests.

components.name: Library source
components.responsibility: The JSON layer, the typed layer and the native adapters.

components.name: Tests and example suites
components.responsibility: Fixture runners, typed-layer and JSON-layer tests, the purity check, and the UTV-first and native-first examples.

components.name: Conformance material
components.responsibility: The everyday and text-form fixtures, the structural examples and the demo zone rules, read by the tests at run time.

components.name: serde_json, serde and regex crates
components.responsibility: JSON values and parsing, and regular expressions: the library's only default dependencies.

components.name: chrono crate
components.responsibility: Calendar types for the native adapters (optional feature chrono) and the native side of the examples.

components.name: chrono-tz crate
components.responsibility: Named zones for the native side of the examples, with the IANA tz database compiled in (dev-dependency).

components.name: std::time::SystemTime
components.responsibility: Rust's standard clock-reading type, which the library converts to and from instants.

relationships.description: include_str! at compile time, three folders up from src/lib.rs.

With the feature chrono only: utv::interop::chrono.
Through the public API; the crate is its own dev-dependency with the feature chrono on.
Reads everyday.json, text-form.json, examples/ and rules/demo-zones.json relative to CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR.
